fields.Name: T174 - Filter Products Grid
fields.Description: Verifies that the grid quick-filter on the Products grid responds to a typed term by narrowing the visible rows (or showing a clear no-match state).

InputDefinition.goal: To open the 'Products' entity, use the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box - type 'Products' and click the node named EXACTLY 'Products' (NOT 'Product Categories' or 'Product Awards'). Do NOT fight a group expand-chevron. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Once the Products grid is loaded, type a term such as 'Cheddar' into the grid's quick-filter box ('Filter records...'). NOTE: this quick-filter is CLIENT-SIDE over the rows already loaded on the current page, so do NOT expect it to find a specific off-page record. Success is reached when the grid visibly RESPONDS to the filter - the displayed rows narrow to those matching the term, OR the grid shows a clear no-match / empty state for that term.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Products entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
A term (e.g. 'Cheddar') has been entered into the grid's quick-filter ('Filter records...') box
The grid visibly responds to the filter: the displayed rows narrow to matches OR a clear no-match/empty state is shown for that term
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
